articulation.label: January
articulation.alt: January: /dʒ/ → /æ/ → /n/ → /j/ → /u/ → /ɛ/ → /r/ → /i/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /dʒ/: Brief closure and release, with voice.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/j/: Front tongue high; glide into the next vowel.
/u/: High back tongue; round the lips.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
